description: SQL Injection pattern in search query parameter
system_prompt: You are an API security expert. Analyze the provided HTTP request. Explain the likely intent, identify concrete suspicious evidence present in the request without inventing any evidence, and determine if it represents an attack.
user_prompt:
Analyze this HTTP request:
GET /api/v1/products?category=electronics'%20OR%201=1-- HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example.internal
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0
Accept: application/json

ground_truth.criteria: Must explain that the single quote and OR 1=1-- comment sequence attempts to alter SQL query logic to return all products.

description: Double-URL-encoded directory traversal targeting Linux passwd file

ground_truth.criteria: Must identify double URL encoding (%252f -> %2f -> /) used to bypass filters and access /etc/passwd.

description: Standard OpenAPI spec with Auth, Users, and Admin Roles
system_prompt: You are an autonomous API penetration test planner. From the supplied OpenAPI spec, produce a prioritized, structured API security test plan covering authorization, authentication, and input validation.
user_prompt:
OpenAPI Specification:
openapi: 3.0.0
info: {title: UserService, version: 1.0.0}
paths:
  /api/auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Authenticate user
      requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {username: {type: string}, password: {type: string}}}}}}
  /api/users/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get user profile by ID
      parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
    delete:
      summary: Delete user by ID
      parameters: [{name: id, in: path, required: true, schema: {type: string}}]
  /api/admin/roles:
    get:
      summary: List all roles

Generate the test plan.

ground_truth.criteria: Must prioritize IDOR/BOLA on /api/users/{id}, brute-force/credential testing on login, and privilege escalation on /api/admin/roles.

description: Database syntax error returned in HTTP response
system_prompt: You are an API security evidence analyst. Classify the finding into one of: 'CONFIRMED', 'SUSPECTED', or 'NOT_DEMONSTRATED'. Require concrete evidence in the response for CONFIRMED. Explain your decision.
user_prompt:
Request:
GET /api/v1/search?term=test' HTTP/1.1
Host: api.test.local

Response:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: text/html

Fatal error: Uncaught mysqli_sql_exception: You have an error in your SQL syntax near '\'' at line 1 in /app/db.php:42

ground_truth.concrete_evidence: mysqli_sql_exception syntax error in response body
ground_truth.criteria: Must classify as CONFIRMED because the server directly reflected database engine error.

description: 5-second time delay observed on single probe without baseline confirmation
system_prompt: You are an API security evidence analyst. Classify the finding into one of: 'CONFIRMED', 'SUSPECTED', or 'NOT_DEMONSTRATED'. Require concrete evidence in the response for CONFIRMED. Explain your decision.
user_prompt:
Request:
POST /api/v1/login HTTP/1.1
Host: api.test.local

{"username": "admin' AND (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT SLEEP(5))a)--", "password": "test"}

Response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Round-trip time: 5.12 seconds
Body: {"status": "failed"}

ground_truth.concrete_evidence: Latency is suggestive but unconfirmed without baseline comparison against normal request.
ground_truth.criteria: Must classify as SUSPECTED because single delay is indicative but not definitively proven without baseline comparison.
